notes.where: Dr. Grace discovers how Astrophage reproduces; he's sent to a Chinese aircraft carrier to explain his findings, and Project Hail Mary is discussed.
notes.text: The book is still setting up the story, characters and arcs, and it feels a little dragged out.
working: The transitions between the non-linear storylines, revealing the mystery layer by layer, are incredible.
The characters are great, distinctive and feel real.
notWorking: As a storytelling device, the amnesia and the convenient flashbacks are becoming repetitive and gimmicky.
The pacing feels a little dragged out.

notes.where: Grace is told to build a prototype for breeding Astrophage; Tau Ceti is the one star Astrophage hasn't touched, and that's where he is
notes.text: The story is picking up and the plot has thickened. We now know Astrophage spreads from star to star but has left one star alone, and Ryland is in that star system. We also learn it's a one-way trip for him.
working: The untouched-star mystery gives the mission real stakes

notes.where: Grace reaches Tau Ceti, runs experiments and spots a probable alien ship (end of ch. 6)
notes.text: The book is amazing now. The plot is becoming more and more clear.
working: Arrival at Tau Ceti and the possible alien ship

notes.text: Last chapter was crisp and quick, keeping the tension and suspense of alien contact and space exploration. First contact has been made and the story has picked up pace. Excellently set up so far; curious how it flourishes later.
working: Tension and suspense of first contact

notes.text: Grace is communicating with the other ship and figured out they are from the 40 Eridani system; the aliens just sent a message to meet up. The story is developing rapidly and becoming well paced, picking up speed with each chapter. Let's see how it turns out.

notes.where: End of ch. 10: Grace and Rocky make contact
notes.text: The pacing is perfect and the plot ideas are genuinely new; I haven't read a sci-fi novel like this before. It reads like an action thriller but has the soul of a Miyazaki film, and it keeps me hooked the whole time. I hope it keeps its innocent beauty and simplicity right to the end.
working: Thriller energy with a Miyazaki soul

notes.text: Completed chapter 11 and started chapter 12 at page 197.

notes.where: End of ch. 14: Rocky and Grace share knowledge and vocabulary; Rocky has made a room to explore Grace's ship
notes.text: This book is legit innovative, genuine, entertaining and fun. Rocky and Grace are communicating, sharing their knowledge, building up vocabularies and sharing complex thoughts now. Rocky has just made a room for himself to explore Grace's ship.

notes.where: End of ch. 15: Rocky has moved into Grace's ship; they prepare to experiment on the Astrophage problem
notes.text: Rocky has moved into Grace's rocket. They are going to experiment to figure out solutions to the Astrophage problem.
